    Binary normalization #

    Corollary 7.8 (cor:binary-normalization, characteristic-two-construction.tex): if Λ also has a compatible grading by a lattice L, with S in degree zero, μ_i raising L-degree by χ_i, and the χ_i part of an integer basis of L, then every positive filtered deformation is isomorphic to a fibre with all parameters zero or one, and two parameter vectors with the same zero coordinates give isomorphic fibres. "For a : L → k^*, multiply a vector of weight ℓ by a(ℓ). This is an automorphism of (Λ, m), and transporting m_λ along it changes its coefficients to λ'_i = λ_i a(χ_i)."

    The lattice grading is LatGrading (finitely supported projections, as for the length grading); characters are additive maps L → Additive kˣ, extended from the prescribed values on the χ_i through the basis (exists_character).

    structure MultiplicativeBasisDeformations.LatGrading (k : Type u) [Field k] (Λ : Type v) [Ring Λ] [Algebra k Λ] (L : Type) [AddCommGroup L] [DecidableEq L] :
    Type v

    A grading by an abelian group L, with finitely many nonzero components.

    • proj : L → Λ →ₗ[k] Λ
    • supp : Finset L
    • proj_proj (l l' : L) (x : Λ) : (self.proj l) ((self.proj l') x) = if l' = l then (self.proj l') x else 0
    • proj_out (l : L) : l ∉ self.supp → self.proj l = 0
    • sum (x : Λ) : x = ∑ l ∈ self.supp, (self.proj l) x
    • mul_hom (l l' : L) (x y : Λ) : (self.proj (l + l')) ((self.proj l) x * (self.proj l') y) = (self.proj l) x * (self.proj l') y
